entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So that Shadow's the boss of that[n]journalist, Ohya.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ah, it's the Shadow of that Ohya[n]journalist's boss.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He looks so suspicious.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, he is obstructing a news[n]investigation to keep some incident[n]hidden under the rug.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: People died in that incident. He should[n]be ashamed to call himself a journalist.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We'll have to make him see the truth!

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: You... Are you that kid who was hanging[n]around Ohya?

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: Screw you guys. Snooping around[n]together where you shouldn't be...

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: What'll happen if this draws negative[n]attention to me from the higher-ups!?[n]Stop meddling around!
What happened to journalism?
Free Ohya!

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: Don't talk like you know, you child!

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: It'd be better for the organization if we[n]didn't have rebels like her around!

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: You must not care about dying if you[n]oppose me! Just obey those with power[n]if you wanna live!

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: Dammit, dammit, dammit...! What was[n]I supposed to do...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: I can't oppose the higher-ups. It's easier[n]not to rock the boat.

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: Mass media is just another corporation,[n]really. Passion for journalism won't pay[n]the bills.

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: It's useless, just useless to chase after[n]your ideals...
Not to Ohya, it isn't.
Is it really useless?

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: ...She's really incredible.

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: No matter what people say to her, she'll[n]never give up on finding the truth...

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: ...Maybe not for Ohya.

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: No matter what people say to her, she'll[n]never give up on finding the truth...

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: I found her naïve passion to be so[n]annoying. It reminds me of all that[n]pain I felt in the past.

entries.speaker: Shadow Honjo
entries.en: Back in the past, before I gave up. Before[n]my passion rotted away and my wife[n]cheated on me...
Honjo's Shadow disappeared.[n]I should go see Ohya...
